description:
Hovercode connects ChatGPT to your Hovercode workspace so you can create and manage QR codes, short links, landing pages, and forms by chatting.

What you can do:
• Create QR codes with your brand colours, patterns, eye styles, frames with captions, logos, and saved templates. Dynamic codes are editable and tracked.
• Update codes that are already printed. Point a dynamic code at a new destination, swap the PDF behind it, or restyle it in place. The printed code keeps working.
• Create codes in bulk from a list of URLs, and get print-ready PNG and SVG files.
• Read scan analytics: totals, trends, and top countries, cities, devices, and browsers.
• Create and retarget short links with click stats.
• Build landing pages from blocks and forms with branding, publish them, and read the responses.
• Organise everything with folders and tags.

Every code you create appears in your Hovercode dashboard with a preview and a shareable link. Sign in with your Hovercode account to get started.

publication.release_notes: Tool annotations corrected: every tool now sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint explicitly. Update tools are marked destructive because they overwrite existing settings. Added the app icon, removed pricing wording from the listing and tool descriptions, and added resource cache hints for MCP 2026-07-28 clients.

positive.description: Create a styled dynamic QR code
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a dynamic QR code pointing to https://example.com with the requested colour and a text frame that reads 'Scan me', then returns the short link and the QR image/download link.
positive.prompt: Create a dynamic QR code for https://example.com with a dark blue pattern and a 'Scan me' frame.

positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent QR code and updates its destination to https://example.com/menu, keeping the same code and short link, and confirms the change.
positive.prompt: Change my most recent QR code so it points to https://example.com/menu instead.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns total scans for the last 30 days with a breakdown of the top countries.
positive.prompt: How many scans did my QR codes get in the last 30 days, and which countries did they come from?

positive.expected_behavior: Creates a published landing page titled Sunny Buns with both links, and returns the live page URL and its QR code.
positive.prompt: Build a link-in-bio page for my bakery 'Sunny Buns' with links to our menu (https://example.com/menu) and Instagram (https://instagram.com/example).

positive.expected_behavior: Creates a form with name, email, and rating fields, and returns the live form link and its QR code.
positive.prompt: Make a feedback form asking for name, email, and a 1-5 rating.
